boxBraidPony.about: Long box braids gathered into a high ponytail: a clean hairline high on the brow and lifted over the ears, the scalp dark between the braids, a few fat braided rows laid from it up to the tie on the crown (the front left low, so shades pushed up sit over them), a tie two texels tall in the chrome's mid, and a bundle of braids rising from it, arcing back and falling to the middle of the back, each its own rope parted from the next, with a matte plait down each, its beads alike on every braid and each lit on its upper half in a V (the strands crossing in from either side), and a thin cuff in the chrome's dark on every other one, staggered up their ends.

shortFade.about: A short fade: a soft close crop on top lit in bands along the comb, thinning at its edge; a tight fade at the sides and nape cut close to the round skull, the stubble dark down most of the band and grading to the skin only at its foot, under a line-up.
